hints.text: Test each of the n cyclic rotation shifts of string s.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: For each rotation, count pairwise character mismatches using two converging pointers.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Return the minimum mismatch count found across all possible rotations.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minOpsRotatedPalindrome(s: str) -> int:
    n = len(s)
    best = n
    for shift in range(n):
        rot = s[shift:] + s[:shift]
        diffs = sum(1 for i in range(n // 2) if rot[i] != rot[n - 1 - i])
        best = min(best, diffs)
    return best
```
